fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 7% of monthly Gross Sales, may be increased up to 2 percentage points (max 9%). Minimum annual royalty applies: Year 1 $4,550, Year 2 $5,670, Year 3 $7,560, Year 4 $9,450, Year 5 $11,340 — difference paid if 12-month royalties fall short. Brand Fund Fee is 1% of Gross Sales (may increase to max 2%). Local Advertising Requirement up to 2% of Gross Sales. Advertising Cooperative Contribution up to 2% of Gross Sales. Software License Fee is tiered on Gross Sales per calendar year: 2% on first $50,000; 1.75% on next $200,000; 1% on next $250,000; 0.5% on next $500,000; 0.25% on Gross Sales over $1,000,000 (max 3%). Franchise Advisory Council Fee: $100/year per franchise. Transfer Fee: 20% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Renewal Fee: $5,000. Non-Compliance Fees: $250–$750 per deviation. Late P&L Upload Fee: $50/$100/$150. Late Report Fee: $50/month. Returned Check/Insufficient Funds Fee: $50/occurrence. Convention Fee: up to $500/attendee. Additional Training/Assistance: $0–$350/diem plus expenses.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee: 7% of your monthly Gross Sales (but in no event less than the Minimum Royalty Fee, as defined below in Note 3). Due monthly on previous day's Gross Sales. We may increase the Royalty Fee at any time during the term of the Franchise Agreement by up to 2 percentage points (Royalty Fee will not exceed 9% of Gross Sales).
Brand Fund Fee: 1% of your Gross Sales. As incurred. We reserve the right to increase the fee, not to exceed 2% of your Gross Sales.
Local Advertising Requirement: Up to 2% of your Gross Sales. As incurred.
Advertising Cooperative Contribution: Up to 2% of your Gross Sales. As incurred.
Software License Fee: 2% on the first $50,000 of Gross Sales in each calendar year; 1.75% on next $200,000 in Gross Sales of each calendar year; 1% on next $250,000 of Gross Sales in each calendar year; 0.5% on next $500,000 of Gross Sales in each calendar year; 0.25% on any Gross Sales over $1,000,000 in each calendar year. Due monthly on previous day's Gross Sales.
Franchise Advisory Council Fee: Annual fee of $100 per Franchise.
Minimum Royalty Fee: First year $4,550; Second year $5,670; Third year $7,560; Fourth year $9,450; Fifth year $11,340.
